title: Engine Oil Leak-Detection Material
introduction:
I use this table like a bottle-label lookup: match the full product name and identifier in Item, then check Specification for an accompanying requirement. The listed material is a gasoline engine oil leak-detection dye; its Specification cell gives no specification value.

This reference identifies the material for a leak-diagnosis job. Quantity, mixing, application and inspection instructions are outside this table, so keep the applicable leak-diagnosis procedure alongside it.

edits.why: The table supplies a material identity and product identifier. An unfilled specification entry does not establish a quantity, usage instruction or acceptable substitute.
